contradictions.description: The figure adds the H term to the maximized objective, whereas Equation (4) subtracts the cross-entropy penalty. These formulations give opposite optimization incentives for cross-entropy.

quotes:
On sycophancy, both RESGA and SAEGA achieve error rates statistically indistinguishable
from $50\%$ , indicating effective neutralization rather than behavioral reversal.
contradictions.description: The blanket summary describes both methods as neutralizing sycophancy at approximately 50%, but the Gemma results are 62.65% and 70.70%. The summary does not distinguish those results from the near-50% results for Llama and Qwen.

quotes:
On hallucination and myopic reward,
both methods yield consistent improvements over baselines.
contradictions.description: The improvements are not consistent across the reported baselines and settings. Both methods lose to Standard Prompt on Qwen hallucination and to ProTeGi on Gemma hallucination and Qwen myopic reward; SAEGA also loses to Standard Prompt on Gemma myopic reward.
